bullets.text: Underwriting profit margin reached 8.4% versus 0.3% for the industry and 6.6% in 1997; Personal Lines underwriting profit margin was 7.9%; goal is at least a 4% underwriting profit over customer retention.

Personal Lines NPW grew 15% YOY to $4,922.3 million (93% of total NPW), representing 4.0% of U.S. personal lines premiums; other business revenues reached $405 million with pretax profit up 68% to $62 million.
Distributed across 30,000+ Independent Agents, five call centers via 1 800 AUTO PRO, online via progressive.com, and 200+ Strategic Alliances; each channel assigned a Policy Team leader for 1999.

Debt to debt plus capital was 23.3%; repurchased 393,000 shares at $104 average cost; filed $300 million debt shelf; earned $221.3 million after-tax investment income; held $4,532.9 million in investment-grade fixed maturities.

Expanded regular TV advertising into 43 new markets (83 total); sponsored Super Bowl XXXIII Halftime Show; introduced commercials with E.T.; expanded Immediate Response Vehicle fleet to strengthen brand awareness.

Used financial responsibility in 43 states; introduced next-generation product design in mid-1998, expecting it in markets representing 80% of premium by April 1999; early results suggest attracting more drivers across all risk profiles.

Performance-based Gainsharing program paid $107.5 million for 1998 versus $85.8 million for 1997; hired and trained over 3,800 people; split CEO role into Insurance Operations and Investments and Capital Management.

Ranked as the 5th largest U.S. auto insurer; captured motorcycle market share leadership from State Farm; held market leadership in selling auto insurance through Independent Agents and online via progressive.com.

Auto insurance reached its most profitable period in 20 years as loss experience steadily improved. Insurers increased advertising and cut rates; operating margins may soon shrink and turn negative for the industry.

Enabled online quotes in 47 states and purchase in 23 states plus DC; launched "Personal Progressive" internet policyholder self-service; completed nearly 100% of Y2K system remediations with testing in Time Warp Lab.
